description: This file defines the ShoppingCartService interface for managing shopping cart operations within an e-commerce system, including cart retrieval, updates, merging, and shipping requirements.

classes.name: ShoppingCartService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing shopping carts, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, merging, and shipping assessments.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a shopping cart.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a shopping cart by its ID and store context.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart using its code and store.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Fetches the shopping cart for a specific customer.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Creates shipping products based on cart items, returns null for virtual items.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Checks whether the shopping cart (or items) are free of charge.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Creates a ShoppingCartItem from a Product, including attributes.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes a shopping cart from the system.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merges user and session shopping carts into a single cart.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if the shopping cart requires shipping.
